name: pdf-book-splitter-workspace
description: Workspace root for pdf-book-splitter: the platform-agnostic core engine, the CLI, and (later) desktop/mobile shells built on top of it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/cli
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run dev -w apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/cli
